name: Charles Burkett

items.why: Using an AI avatar that he disclosed himself, which he says helps him compete with his opponents' larger budgets, is a campaign-style choice with no finding of wrongdoing and no bearing on any criterion.

This item describes no conduct by him, only that the foreign-ties records searched (FARA filings, foreign-government payments and similar) turned up nothing; any AIPAC-related records are counted in a separate step.

for_review: The WUSF page fetch was truncated, so I read the Burkett passage only in the search-result text (it matches item 1). The one search on the owner's named sites returned nothing relevant to Burkett. Item 2 is an absence of records, and I did not independently search FARA or foreign-agent databases. Other items I saw but did not use because they don't meet the against/open bar: (a) a 2021 WSVN/Inside Edition story about bodycam video of him telling a female officer 'I had a crush on you' after he called 911 about loud music, which he denied was harassment; (b) 2023 complaints that he made against another mayor, in which he was the accuser; (c) a dismissed 2020 ethics complaint that he filed himself. CIVICS Scorecard says it found no formal ethics complaints against him. His campaign site says he is a real estate investment firm owner and four-term Surfside mayor, which suggests real work. His self-description as 'Donalds without his baggage and being bought and paid for' is a campaign claim, not a finding. I did not check his property or business holdings, the self-funding source or his attendance as mayor. Those are worth a look if time allows.
